description: AUTOPILOT project partners provide two sets of three-vehicle fleet-rebalancing tests between car-sharing stations in Versailles. Spatial coverage is the documented route. An operator drives the lead vehicle with Traffic Light Assist guidance and following vehicles drive automatically. One deposit records only real signals at intersections 422 and 447. The other includes additional simulated signals and explicitly warns that decisions near those simulated lights are not relevant. Described contents include CAN/GPS vehicle and lateral-control data, vehicle-to-vehicle TCP/WLAN payload records and oneM2M exchanges between platooning services and signal controllers. The two deposits remain separate components in this grouped record, without asserting disjoint observation samples. The related urban-driving collection concerns car sharing and road-user detection. Exact timing, payload encodings and current traffic-light operation require source-file review before reuse. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
